text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "In a high-dimensional neural network potential, the total energy E of the system is represented as a sum of atomic contributions Ei, E = sum over i of Ei [W2025444507#003][W4312043350#015]. Each atomic contribution Ei is produced by a subnet that takes the atom's symmetry function values as input, and summing these contributions yields the total energy [W2025444507#003][W2025444507#005]. This decomposition is also what makes the total energy invariant to interchanging atoms of the same type, since the subnets share identical structure and weights [W2025444507#003][W2025444507#004]. In ANI, the same relation holds, with ET computed as the sum of the atomic outputs Ei [W2541404351#007]."}
